mass.quantity: surface mass anomaly from the JPL mascon solution summed over one ice sheet's land mascons, per solution month
mass.product: JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO MASCON RL06.3Mv04 CRI
mass.variable: lwe_thickness (with uncertainty, land_mask, mascon_ID, lat_bounds, lon_bounds, time_bounds)
mass.grid: 0.5 degree grid representing 3 degree spherical-cap mascons; cell areas from the latitude and longitude bounds on a sphere of radius 6371 km
mass.mask: the granule's land_mask (1 is land, the CRI partition); the ice sheet's mascon set by the rule each series states
mass.aggregation: sum over the land cells of the selected mascons of lwe_thickness (cm) times the cell area (km2) times 1e-5 Gt; one sigma per mascon times its land area, in quadrature over the selected mascons
mass.reference: anomaly against the product's own baseline (the 2004 to 2009 mean)
mass.sampling: monthly: one row per solution, labelled by the calendar month of the midpoint of its time_bounds; missing months absent
mass.units: value_gt and uncertainty_gt in gigatonnes; land_area_km2 in km2
mass.sign_convention: positive is mass gained (more equivalent water thickness), the product's own

month_assignments.reason: midpoint month already taken by the previous solution; the span reaches into the following month, which the product's month list labels it

mass.uncertainty_basis: formal: the granule's one sigma per mascon over the mascon's land area, in quadrature, mascons treated as independent; a floor where mascon errors correlate; leakage is not in it

bookkeeping.gia: ICE-6G_D (Peltier and others 2018) subtracted by the product before the CRI filter and from the released fields (the release note; the podaac bundle's GIA gotcha); nothing re-applied. Over Antarctica the GIA model is the largest systematic of a gravimetric mass balance and is not in the formal error below
bookkeeping.low_degree: C20 and C30 from TN-14 version 3 across the whole series, degree 1 from JPL's mascon-consistent geocenter; nothing re-applied (the release note; the podaac bundle's low-degree gotcha)
bookkeeping.reference_frame: centre of figure restored through JPL's mascon-consistent geocenter (degree 1 computed with the mascon field as background, the release note)
bookkeeping.effective_smoothing: 3 degree spherical-cap mascons on a 0.5 degree grid; the sum runs over whole mascons, so signal from the ice-free land and the ocean inside a selected mascon, and ice signal in an excluded neighbour, is leakage the product's CRI filter reduces and does not remove (the podaac bundle's coastal-leakage gotcha)
bookkeeping.gad: the GAD de-aliasing signal is restored over the ocean part of the mascons only (the release note); the land cells summed here carry none
bookkeeping.elastic_and_hydrology: no elastic rebound or terrestrial hydrology correction is applied to the mascons: the product's land mascon value is the full surface mass anomaly

greenland.rule: the product's land mascons whose land area is covered by Greenland ice (the ITS_LIVE mask, ice sheet and peripheral glaciers) for at least 0.25 of it

ice_mask.title: ITS_LIVE Greenland Grounded Ice Sheet and Peripheral Glacier Ice Elevation Change

antarctica.rule: every land mascon whose centroid lies south of 60 S; the CRI land mask marks the floating ice shelves as land, so the sum spans the grounded sheet and the shelves together

greenland.rule: the provider's series is read for this comparison only; the sum above is never adjusted to it. Its monthly uncertainty includes leakage (its header), the formal error here does not

antarctica.rule: the provider's series is read for this comparison only; the sum above is never adjusted to it. Its monthly uncertainty includes leakage (its header), the formal error here does not

product_and_version.greenland: ICESat-2 ATL15 Gridded Antarctic and Arctic Land Ice Height Change, Version 5 (product version , doi 10.5067/ATLAS/ATL15.005)
product_and_version.antarctica: ICESat-2 ATL15 Gridded Antarctic and Arctic Land Ice Height Change, Version 5 (product version , doi 10.5067/ATLAS/ATL15.005)

grid.greenland: 10 km polar stereographic, 274 by 154 cells; the cell area is the product's ice_area (m2), the ice-covered area of the cell
grid.antarctica: 10 km polar stereographic, 227 by 263 cells; the cell area is the product's ice_area (m2), the ice-covered area of the cell

mask.greenland: the product's ice_area above zero at every epoch: the Greenland ice sheet and the peripheral ice caps the GL region covers, undivided; no grounding mask (Greenland's floating tongues are in the sum)
mask.antarctica: the product's ice_area above zero at every epoch in each quadrant granule, the four quadrants summed per epoch; grounded and floating ice together, since the product carries no grounding mask

aggregation.greenland: sum of delta_h times the cell's minimum ice_area over the epochs, over the fixed set of cells finite in delta_h and delta_h_sigma and ice-covered at every epoch; 1e-3 km3 per m km2
aggregation.antarctica: per quadrant, sum of delta_h times the cell's minimum ice_area over the epochs, over the fixed set of cells finite in delta_h and delta_h_sigma and ice-covered at every epoch; the quadrants summed, their quadrature errors in quadrature and their linear bounds added

reference.greenland: anomaly against the ATL14 reference surface at 2020-01-01, the product's own
reference.antarctica: anomaly against the ATL14 reference surface at 2020-01-01, the product's own

sampling.greenland: quarterly: one row per product epoch, labelled by the calendar month of its time value
sampling.antarctica: quarterly: one row per product epoch, labelled by the calendar month of its time value

volume-atl15.units: value_km3, uncertainty_km3 and uncertainty_correlated_km3 in km3 of surface height change (not ice); area_km2 in km2
volume-atl15.sign_convention: positive is a higher surface (more volume), the product's own

uncertainty_basis.greenland: delta_h_sigma times area in quadrature over the cells (a floor where errors correlate across cells) and the same summed linearly (the bound where they correlate fully), both carried
uncertainty_basis.antarctica: delta_h_sigma times area in quadrature over the cells (a floor where errors correlate across cells) and the same summed linearly (the bound where they correlate fully), both carried

volume-atl15.not_mass: a volume of surface height change: the firn air content change is removed and a density applied by the computation, never here (the bundle's gotcha atl15-height-change-is-not-mass-change)

domains.greenland/ice_sheet: the grounded Greenland Ice Sheet (mask 1 of the ITS_LIVE Greenland product); firn and volume-itslive
domains.greenland/peripheral_glaciers: the peripheral glaciers of Greenland (mask 2); firn and volume-itslive
domains.greenland/land_mascons: the JPL land mascons selected for Greenland by the mass stamp's rule: the ice sheet, the peripheral glaciers and the ice-free land and coastal ocean inside those mascons; mass
domains.greenland/gl: the ATL15 GL region (ice sheet and peripheral ice caps, undivided); volume-atl15 when present
domains.antarctica/ice_shelves: the floating Antarctic ice shelves (ID 1 to 182 of the ice shelf product); firn and surface mass balance; not the grounded ice sheet
domains.antarctica/land_mascons: every JPL land mascon south of 60 S: the grounded sheet and the floating shelves together; mass
domains.antarctica/grounded: the grounded Antarctic Ice Sheet of the ITS_LIVE grounded product; volume-itslive when present
domains.antarctica/a1_a4: the four ATL15 Antarctic quadrants summed, grounded and floating together; volume-atl15 when present

greenland.altimetry: volume over greenland/ice_sheet plus greenland/peripheral_glaciers (volume-itslive) or over greenland/gl (volume-atl15), less the firn air content volume over the same two firn domains, times a stated ice density
greenland.input_output: not possible from this root: it holds no Greenland surface mass balance and no discharge; the published input-output estimates are IMBIE's input-output group (Otosaka and others 2023)

antarctica.altimetry: not possible from this root: the firn term covers the floating ice shelves only (antarctica/ice_shelves) and no grounded Antarctic firn air content field is in the ITS_LIVE distribution, so the grounded volume (antarctica/grounded, present) cannot be converted to mass; the computation refuses
antarctica.input_output: not possible from this root: the surface mass balance covers the ice shelves only and there is no discharge

bookkeeping.reading_rule: a computation reads rows by ice_sheet and domain and by the sampling column; a quarterly row is one product time step labelled by the month of its time value, not a monthly value, and no month is ever filled
